import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load datasets
train = pd.read_parquet('train.parquet')
train_neg = pd.read_parquet('train_neg.parquet')

# 2. Filter to task_id == 103
df_succ = train[train['task_id'] == 103].copy()
df_unsucc = train_neg[train_neg['task_id'] == 103].copy()

# Label status
df_succ['status'] = 'successful'
df_unsucc['status'] = 'unsuccessful'

# 3. QED_delta analysis
# Drop nulls for QED_delta
succ_qed = df_succ.dropna(subset=['QED_delta'])
unsucc_qed = df_unsucc.dropna(subset=['QED_delta'])

# Group statistics for QED_delta
mean_succ_qed = succ_qed['QED_delta'].mean()
var_succ_qed = succ_qed['QED_delta'].var()
n_succ_qed = succ_qed.shape[0]
mean_unsucc_qed = unsucc_qed['QED_delta'].mean()
var_unsucc_qed = unsucc_qed['QED_delta'].var()
n_unsucc_qed = unsucc_qed.shape[0]

print("QED_delta statistics for task_id=103:")
print(f"  Successful edits: n={n_succ_qed}, mean={mean_succ_qed:.4f}, var={var_succ_qed:.4f}")
print(f"  Unsuccessful edits: n={n_unsucc_qed}, mean={mean_unsucc_qed:.4f}, var={var_unsucc_qed:.4f}\n")

# 4. T-test for QED_delta (Welch's)
t_stat, p_val = stats.ttest_ind(succ_qed['QED_delta'], unsucc_qed['QED_delta'],
                                 equal_var=False, nan_policy='omit')
print(f"Welch's t-test for QED_delta: t={t_stat:.4f}, p-value={p_val:.4e}\n")

# 5. MW_delta variance comparison
# Drop nulls for MW_delta
succ_mw = df_succ.dropna(subset=['MW_delta'])
unsucc_mw = df_unsucc.dropna(subset=['MW_delta'])

var_succ_mw = succ_mw['MW_delta'].var()
var_unsucc_mw = unsucc_mw['MW_delta'].var()
n_succ_mw = succ_mw.shape[0]
n_unsucc_mw = unsucc_mw.shape[0]
print("MW_delta statistics for task_id=103:")
print(f"  Successful edits: n={n_succ_mw}, var={var_succ_mw:.4f}")
print(f"  Unsuccessful edits: n={n_unsucc_mw}, var={var_unsucc_mw:.4f}\n")

# Levene's test for MW_delta variances
e_stat, e_p = stats.levene(succ_mw['MW_delta'], unsucc_mw['MW_delta'], center='median')
print(f"Levene's test for MW_delta variances: stat={e_stat:.4f}, p-value={e_p:.4e}\n")

# 6. Visualization
sns.set(style='whitegrid')
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 5))

# Boxplot for QED_delta
data_qed = pd.concat([succ_qed[['status', 'QED_delta']],
                      unsucc_qed[['status', 'QED_delta']]])
sns.boxplot(x='status', y='QED_delta', data=data_qed, ax=axes[0])
axes[0].set_title('QED_delta by Success Status (task 103)')

# Boxplot for MW_delta
fw = pd.concat([succ_mw[['status', 'MW_delta']],
                unsucc_mw[['status', 'MW_delta']]])
sns.boxplot(x='status', y='MW_delta', data=fw, ax=axes[1])
axes[1].set_title('MW_delta by Success Status (task 103)')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
